criteria: Location decks: each region type spawns contextual situations
Quest system: short jobs, quest chains, personal trials with branching resolutions
Economy: coin, reagents, focus as world resources with earn/spend mechanics
Markets: supply/demand per city with price collapse on oversell
Travel system: move between hexes, spend days, encounter checks
Mage progression: elemental mastery deeds, reputation tracks, titles
Deck management: grimoire vs prepared deck, swap at inns/colleges
Time system: 12-week calendar, actions cost days
Browser smoke: travel → encounter → combat → reward → shop → deck swap
